slurGitHub

/slur for GitHub Copilot CLI

slur generator for GitHub Copilot CLI

Install a local insult and slur generator as a GitHub Copilot CLI custom skill. Every standalone /slur token produces a random one-to-five-term combination.

how it works

The prompt hook replaces the model-facing prompt with the expanded text. Copilot CLI may still show the submitted /slur text in the conversation.

adapter
GitHub Copilot CLI custom skill and prompt hook
runtime
local Rust binary
default Unix path
~/.copilot/skills/slur and ~/.copilot/hooks/slur.json
invoke
/slur anywhere in a prompt
network
none while generating

install

  1. macOS / Linux
    curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/darhebkf/slur/main/scripts/install.sh | bash -s -- copilot
  2. Windows PowerShell
    irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/darhebkf/slur/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex
    slur setup copilot
  3. reload

    Restart GitHub Copilot CLI after setup so it loads the skill and hook.

use /slur

You /slur your work needs another pass, you /slur.

Each token expands independently. Use slur block "word" to hide a term, slur add "phrase" to add one, and slur off to disable output.

questions

Is /slur a cloud service?
No. Generation and filtering happen on your machine.
Does it send prompts or telemetry?
No. The generator makes no network requests while producing text.
Can I block words?
Yes. The block list is local, case-insensitive, and editable from the CLI.
